reasoning: Recent Alabama coverage in the last 45 days points overwhelmingly to a strongly Republican Senate environment, with one recent poll showing a 15-point GOP lead and another article explicitly describing a new poll giving Doug Jones an opening but still framing the seat as Republican-favored. Alabama’s statewide Cook PVI is R+15, reinforcing the structural Republican lean. I found no credible recent statewide presidential general-election poll specific to Alabama in the last 45 days, so the current race signal is best represented by the Senate race and broader Republican structural advantage.

sources.name: Pollsmax
